reason: Plugin development utility that manages extensible blueprints, generates DSH plugin code, and statically validates definitions; the README states it does not read or write files or access credentials and only exposes local blueprint metadata.

summaries.zh: 用于通过蓝图登记、脚手架生成和静态校验来开发 DeepSeek Harness 插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin development utility for registering blueprints, scaffolding plugin code, and statically validating definitions.

capabilities: Registers a foundry service for blueprint registration
Provides tools to list blueprints, scaffold plugin code, and validate blueprints
Generates host and browser plugin code from blueprint parameters
Registers a local read-only GET /foundry/state route
Provides a read-only settings gallery for blueprint metadata
